user.title: Thesla Green ModBUS
user.description: Enter a device name (prefix for entity names and IDs) and how to connect.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure – connection type
reconfigure.description: Select the connection type (you can keep the current one).

data_description.timeout: How long to wait for a response (s).
data_description.delay: Delay after connecting – some devices need it (typically 1–2 s). Only affects the first request.
data_description.message_wait_ms: Wait between requests. Default 30 ms for serial, 0 for others.
data_description.slave: Unit ID of the device on the bus (older name: slave ID). 0 is broadcast – you cannot read from it.

entities.title: Select entities
entities.description: Untick entities you do not want. Their registers will not be polled.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect (check address/port or serial port).
error.no_response: Connected, but the device does not answer – check Unit ID, line settings and connection type.
error.already_configured: This connection with this Unit ID is already configured.
